name: week
title: Weekly attribution review
subtitle: Private snapshot. Credit allocation does not prove causal lift.

sections.title: Channel credit
sections.sql: SELECT channel,currency,sum(linear_cents)::bigint AS credited_cents FROM attribution_credit GROUP BY channel,currency ORDER BY currency,channel

sections.title: Won deals without eligible evidence
sections.sql: SELECT * FROM unattributed ORDER BY code

sections.title: Needs attention
sections.sql: SELECT * FROM attention ORDER BY reason,record

sections.title: Privacy review
sections.sql: SELECT * FROM compliance_findings ORDER BY rule,record

sections.title: First, last and linear credit
sections.sql: SELECT channel,currency,sum(first_cents)::bigint AS first_cents,sum(last_cents)::bigint AS last_cents,sum(linear_cents)::bigint AS linear_cents FROM attribution_credit GROUP BY channel,currency ORDER BY currency,channel
